dict.string: When you opt in to voice input or Hey Jarvis listening, Jarvis uses the microphone for on-device transcription. Mute or Stop all ends capture.
Jarvis uses on-device recognition. Hey Jarvis commands can send to your idle selected conversation; manual and blocked commands stay for review.
With desktop access enabled and your approval, the JarvisControl helper reads text from the main screen. Approved text may be sent to the cloud model.
With Apple services enabled and your approval, Jarvis asks Mail, Calendar and Messages to perform the exact account operation you approved.
